footer.summary: A capstone legal-tech platform focused on helping non-lawyers understand contracts before they sign.
footer.disclaimer: AI-assisted explanations can improve clarity and risk awareness, but they do not replace licensed legal advice.
footer.audienceLine: Designed for people who handle real-life contracts but do not speak legal language every day.

hero.title: Understand Contracts Before You Sign
hero.description: Misharu helps shop owners, tenants, employees, and families read legal documents in plain language, spot risky clauses, and know when a human lawyer should step in.
hero.disclaimer: AI-assisted explanations support understanding. They do not replace licensed legal advice.
highlights: A clearer path to lawyer support when needed
hero.previewPreparedFor: Prepared for a grocery shop in Sulaymaniyah
hero.summaryText: The supplier can end the contract quickly, while the shop still faces late payment penalties and limited negotiation rights.
hero.flaggedClauseText: "The supplier may terminate this agreement without notice while outstanding penalties remain payable by the client."
hero.plainLanguageText: This means the other side can stop supplying goods fast, but you may still owe money if they say you broke the agreement.
hero.nextStepText: Review the termination and penalty clauses, then compare them with a standard supplier template or consult a lawyer.

audience.title: Built for people like Mohammad.
audience.description: Mohammad is a grocery shop owner in Sulaymaniyah. He has real business experience, but no legal training. Misharu is being designed to translate hidden legal risk into clear, useful language for people in his position.
personaNeeds: He understands business, but not every legal phrase hidden inside a contract.
He needs fast explanations before agreeing to supplier or rental terms.
He wants reliable guidance without paying for a lawyer at every step.
He still needs a clear path to expert help when the risk is serious.

supportAreas.title: Small business contracts
supportAreas.desc: Supplier agreements, shop leases, service terms, and payment clauses that affect daily business decisions.

supportAreas.title: Plain-language understanding
supportAreas.desc: Complex legal language gets translated into practical wording that non-lawyers can act on.

supportAreas.title: Human escalation when needed
supportAreas.desc: The platform should help users recognise when a lawyer review is worth the cost and urgency.

supportAreas.title: Safer signing decisions
supportAreas.desc: Risk indicators and clause-level warnings help users slow down before agreeing to one-sided terms.

howItWorks.title: A simple legal workflow for people who are not lawyers.
howItWorks.description: The goal is not to impress users with AI. The goal is to help them read faster, understand better, and avoid signing harmful terms by mistake.

steps.title: Upload a contract
steps.desc: Start with the document you already have, such as a rental, supplier, employment, or service agreement.

steps.title: Review the risky parts
steps.desc: The platform should flag unusual clauses, show the contract structure, and highlight areas that deserve attention.

steps.title: Ask follow-up questions
steps.desc: Users can ask for a simpler explanation of a clause or request a short overall summary in plain language.

steps.title: Decide or escalate
steps.desc: If the contract still looks risky, the user can compare templates or move to the lawyer finder for human support.

features.title: Powerful Features for Confident Decisions
features.description: Misharu is not meant to be a single chatbot. It combines AI-assisted legal Q&A with automated contract-review tools, comparison, search, and lawyer-discovery features to help you understand, analyze, and act on contracts with more confidence.

items.title: Document upload and analysis
items.desc: Upload a contract and review rule-based clause detection, risk flags, structure, and an overall explanation in one workspace.

items.title: Clause explainer
items.desc: Select a clause and receive a simpler explanation generated from detected clause type, context, and highlighted wording.

items.title: AI legal question answering
items.desc: Ask follow-up questions about a contract or a legal term and receive guided answers with a clear safety disclaimer.

items.title: Document comparison engine
items.desc: Compare an original contract against a revised version to find added clauses, removed sections, wording changes, and higher-risk edits.

items.title: Risk scoring and safer decisions
items.desc: Use pattern-based risk levels and reasons to spot clauses that deserve more caution before signing.

items.title: Template library
items.desc: Browse ready-made contract templates by category and use them as a reference before accepting a one-sided agreement.

items.title: Lawyer finder
items.desc: Filter lawyers by city and specialty when the user needs a human review for a high-risk contract.

hero.returningDescription: Track saved analyses, reopen a contract, and keep an eye on risk patterns across your recent legal work.

compare.title: Benchmark a contract against a template or compare versions
compare.description: Use one workspace for contract-versus-template review or original-versus-revised comparison, then inspect missing clauses, wording changes, and higher-risk edits.
